snippet.title: Hunternet Starfighter - Now on Indiegogo
snippet.description:
Now on Indiegogo: https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/hunternet-starfighter/
More Details: https://hunternet.gg Our Community: https://discord.gg/hunternet
Fly the Demo and Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1512190/Hunternet_Starfighter/

Hunternet Starfighter is a massively multiplayer starfighter sim where you will fight for control over territory, resources, and key installations during humanity's last great civil war. Form player-owned organizations, mine for resources, and build your own fleet of capital ships to back up your starfighters as you wage war on your enemies. Take a break from the war and participate in friendly races and wargames, but never let your guard down as a mysterious alien enemy threatens to end all of humanity.
